spacing.rhythm: compact daily work, generous sectional separation

shadows.use: reserved for temporary notices and identity mark

must: Keep evidence, review, reconciliation, and close packet findable within one daily flow.
Use the supplied TP mark as compact brand identity.
Preserve all specialist capabilities without presenting 21 peer tabs.
avoid: Generic AI SaaS gradients, decorative glass, fabricated live metrics, and card-grid dashboards.

decisions: Evidence Ledger workspace: six daily close destinations; specialist tools nest in a native select control; blue is reserved for identity and intentional action.
